in_marathi.name: Ganapati
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Ganas (followers)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ganapati हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ganesha is the god of wisdom, new beginnings, and the removal of obstacles. He is the lord of the Ganas, the collective group of all other gods, and is also the god of culture, arts, and sciences.
